scripts.deploy: powershell -Command "Copy-Item -Path 'index.template.html' -Destination 'index.html' -Force; Remove-Item -Path 'dist' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Path 'assets' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; npm run build; Copy-Item -Path 'dist\assets' -Destination 'assets' -Recurse -Force; Copy-Item -Path 'dist\index.html' -Destination 'index.html' -Force; git add .; git commit -m 'Deploy update to main'; git push origin main"
